questions.question: ___ honesty is an important quality.
questions.explanation: Abstract nouns used in a general sense take no article.

questions.question: My sister speaks ___ French fluently.
questions.explanation: Names of languages generally take no article.

questions.question: ___ students should respect their teachers.
questions.explanation: Plural nouns used to make general statements take no article.

questions.question: We usually have ___ breakfast at 8 a.m.
questions.explanation: Names of meals generally take no article.

questions.question: She enjoys playing ___ badminton.
questions.explanation: Names of sports and games generally take no article.

questions.question: ___ water is essential for life.
questions.explanation: Uncountable nouns used generally take no article.

questions.question: Ravi travelled to ___ Japan last year.
questions.explanation: Most country names take no article.

questions.question: My uncle works in ___ Bengaluru.
questions.explanation: Names of cities generally take no article.

questions.question: ___ gold is used in jewellery.
questions.explanation: Material nouns used in a general sense take no article.

questions.question: They go to ___ school every weekday.
questions.explanation: The expression 'go to school' uses zero article when referring to the normal purpose of the institution.

questions.question: ___ elderly deserve care and respect.
questions.explanation: Use 'the' before adjectives such as 'elderly' when referring to a group of people.

questions.question: She prefers ___ coffee without sugar.
questions.explanation: Coffee used as an uncountable noun in a general sense takes no article.

questions.question: We watched ___ television after dinner.
questions.explanation: The expression 'watch television' generally takes no article.

questions.question: ___ Mount Fuji is a famous landmark in Japan.
questions.explanation: Individual mountain peaks generally take no article.

questions.question: He has great ___ patience with children.
questions.explanation: The abstract noun 'patience' is uncountable and used generally here.

questions.question: My cousins play ___ chess every evening.
questions.explanation: Names of games generally take no article.

questions.question: She is studying ___ mathematics at college.
questions.explanation: Names of academic subjects generally take no article.

questions.question: ___ milk in this bottle has turned sour.
questions.explanation: Use 'the' because the phrase 'in this bottle' identifies specific milk.

questions.question: They travelled by ___ train.
questions.explanation: Means of transport after 'by' generally take no article.

questions.question: ___ people need clean air to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: The plural noun 'people' is used generally, so no article is needed.
